Note. Cross-sectional models predict the Wave 1 outcome from the 177 predictors; 9-year change models predict the Wave 2 outcome from the Wave 1 outcome and the same 177 Wave 1 predictors, and the Wave 1 outcome, in the top 20 of every fit, is not ranked or counted. Mean |SHAP| is the mean absolute out-of-bag SHAP value on the outcome's scale over 200 bootstrap fits, with a 95% percentile interval, to four decimals; rank orders it within each model; top-20 stability is the share of fits placing the predictor in the top 20. The first rows count, among the 161 Tier 2 predictors ranked by mean |SHAP|, those needed to reach one half and four fifths of their summed mean |SHAP|, and, among all 177, those entering the top 20 in at least one, at least 60%, and all fits; Spearman ρ correlates the two layers' mean |SHAP| and top-20 overlap is counted over the 19 places left beside the Wave 1 outcome. Top-20 lists, the number of the six outcome-by-layer top-20 lists the predictor enters; the ten entering at least four are the recurring predictors (SI Appendix, Cross-Domain Shared and Unique Predictors).
